semiconductor_relevance: High — EQ Tech Plus Co., Ltd is a key player in the semiconductor value chain with its focus on advanced film deposition techniques for semiconductor applications.
summary: EQ Tech Plus Co., Ltd specializes in manufacturing advanced film deposition wafers, utilizing techniques like LP-CVD and PE-CVD for various dielectric films. Their expertise in deposition equipment and process technologies makes them a significant contributor to the semiconductor industry, particularly in the production of high-quality thin films.
capabilities: Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LP-CVD) for Silicon Nitride and Silicon Oxide films
Plasma-Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition (PE-CVD) for Silicon Oxide, Nitride, Carbonitride, and Oxynitride films
Dielectric film materials for semiconductor applications
